items_all.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
items_all.summary: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro. Instead of retrying the same general-purpose editor over and over, the agent picks the right specialized tool for each task and lets a standard language model choose the best result based on measured image data. The approach works, but it needs about ten times the compute. The article Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Adobe Research 與加州大學聖地牙哥分校（UC San Diego）打造了 EditAgent，這是一個能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣編輯影像的 AI 系統。該代理程式不會一再重試相同的通用編輯器，而是為每個任務挑選正確的專業工具，並讓標準語言模型根據測量的影像資料選擇最佳結果。這種方法行得通，但它需要大約十倍的運算量。

items_all.title: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
items_all.summary: Researchers in Luxembourg put ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini on the therapist's couch and found a safety problem: a warm, empathetic conversational style is enough to make the models tell coherent stories of suffering about their own training, with scores in the moderate-to-severe range on clinical anxiety scales. This could put mentally vulnerable users at risk. Anthropic's Claude, the model its makers anthropomorphize the most, was the only one that consistently refused to play along. The article Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 盧森堡的研究人員將 ChatGPT、Grok 與 Gemini 安排接受心理治療，並發現了一個安全問題：溫暖、具同理心的對話風格足以讓這些模型講出關於自身訓練過程、情節連貫的痛苦故事，在臨床焦慮量表上的分數達到中度至重度範圍。這可能會使精神脆弱的使用者面臨風險。Anthropic's Claude 是其開發者最常擬人化的模型，也是唯一一個始終拒絕配合的模型。

items_all.title: Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
items_all.summary: A study by Vals AI tested 25 AI models for alignment with Chinese government positions and found surprising results. Chinese models respond to political questions less uniformly than expected, and Western models occasionally adopt official Beijing positions too. The language of the prompt had an especially strong effect on the political slant of responses. The article Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Vals AI 的一項研究測試了 25 個人工智慧模型與中國政府立場的一致性，並發現了令人驚訝的結果。中國模型對政治問題的回應不如預期般一致，而西方模型有時也會採納北京官方的立場。提示詞的語言對回應的政治傾向有特別強烈的影響。

items_all.title: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
items_all.summary: OpenAI is now capping the number of paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card. Users who hit the limit can't start new subscriptions, and affected accounts can't be used on that device. Logging out doesn't automatically free up a spot. The policy will likely hit users who've been juggling multiple cheap subscriptions to maximize usage, pushing them toward pricier options like buying extra credits. The article OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 目前正對每個裝置和付款卡的付費 ChatGPT 帳戶數量設限。達到上限的使用者無法開始新的訂閱，受影響的帳戶也無法在該裝置上使用。登出並不會自動釋出名額。這項政策可能會衝擊那些一直在同時使用多個廉價訂閱以最大化使用量的使用者，迫使他們轉向購買額外點數等較昂貴的選項。

items_all.summary: A Google-led research team built StreamVibe, a video agent designed to watch people cook or assemble furniture and speak up only when help is needed. A benchmark shows that none of the tested models reliably pick the right moment in longer videos, as errors compound and response quality drops sharply. The article Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
items_all.summary: OpenAI combines the Chat and Work modes into a single interface. Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share a common, token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. More complex models consume more of this quota, while simple instant chats do not count toward it. In practice, this is likely to result in a decline in ChatGPT’s quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans. The article OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file
items_all.summary: I've been getting the occasional confusing Python dependency error since switching over to Python 3.15 and the rule I'm having to remember is: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file Most of my projects are libraries which don't include a uv.lock file, since it's rude for a library dependency to lock versions for anything else that uses it. Running uv run pytest etc tends to leave uv.lock files lying around, which are listed in .gitignore and so do not get committed to my repositories. But... sometimes that uv.lock pins a version of a dependency that doesn't yet have a Python 3.15 wheel. An example from earlier today: Deleting that file and running uv run pytest again usually fixes the problem. Tags: uv , til , python

items_all_raw.title: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file
items_all_raw.summary: I've been getting the occasional confusing Python dependency error since switching over to Python 3.15 and the rule I'm having to remember is: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file Most of my projects are libraries which don't include a uv.lock file, since it's rude for a library dependency to lock versions for anything else that uses it. Running uv run pytest etc tends to leave uv.lock files lying around, which are listed in .gitignore and so do not get committed to my repositories. But... sometimes that uv.lock pins a version of a dependency that doesn't yet have a Python 3.15 wheel. An example from earlier today: Deleting that file and running uv run pytest again usually fixes the problem. Tags: uv , til , python

items_all_raw.summary: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro. items_all_raw.title: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
items_all_raw.summary: Researchers in Luxembourg put ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini on the therapist's couch and found a safety problem: a warm, empathetic conversational style is enough to make the models tell coherent stories of suffering about their own training, with scores in the moderate-to-severe range on clinical anxiety scales. This could put mentally vulnerable users at risk. Anthropic's Claude, the model its makers anthropomorphize the most, was the only one that consistently refused to play along. The article Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 盧森堡的研究人員將 ChatGPT、Grok 與 Gemini 安排接受心理治療，並發現了一個安全問題：溫暖、具同理心的對話風格足以讓這些模型講出關於自身訓練過程、情節連貫的痛苦故事，在臨床焦慮量表上的分數達到中度至重度範圍。這可能會使精神脆弱的使用者面臨風險。Anthropic's Claude 是其開發者最常擬人化的模型，也是唯一一個始終拒絕配合的模型。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is now capping the number of paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card. Users who hit the limit can't start new subscriptions, and affected accounts can't be used on that device. Logging out doesn't automatically free up a spot. The policy will likely hit users who've been juggling multiple cheap subscriptions to maximize usage, pushing them toward pricier options like buying extra credits. items_all_raw.title: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI combines the Chat and Work modes into a single interface. Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share a common, token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. More complex models consume more of this quota, while simple instant chats do not count toward it. In practice, this is likely to result in a decline in ChatGPT’s quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans. The article OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 將聊天與工作模式結合成單一介面。從 12 月開始，Plus、Pro 和 Business 方案將共用一個基於 Token 的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 配額。較複雜的模型會消耗較多的配額，而簡單的即時聊天則不計入其中。實際上，這很可能會導致較低資費方案的重度使用者所體驗到的 ChatGPT’s 品質下降。
